tagline: A market built around every token — now with AI Autonomous Agent profile & hub strategy.
subheadline: Launch on Pump.fun. Build your market on MART. Configure AI Agents for every token.
enhancement_notice: Additive feature guidelines for MART. Preserves core visual style (Deep Obsidian #080B0D, Emerald #00EFA0, JetBrains Mono, Outfit heading font) and existing routes.

theme_strategy.rationale: Tactical Solana terminal dark mode (#080b0d canvas, #101517 surface) with Emerald (#00efa0) accents and hairline dark borders (#232b2d).
theme_strategy.surface_treatment: Tactical dark glass and semi-solid obsidian panels with 1px border (#232b2d or #294934). Never fully transparent.

brand_identity.wordmark_style: Geometric bold 'MART' with dot matrix slash green mark
brand_identity.positioning: Ecosystem token hub with optional AI Autonomous Agent module (Agency Pad style coin breakdown, agent profile, model selector, agent capabilities, treasury split).

scale.overline: text-xs font-mono font-bold tracking-[0.2em] text-emerald-400 uppercase

hub_tab_extension.navigation_integration: Added as 5th tab alongside Trade, Market, Events, Community in hub-tabs navigation bar (hub-tab-agent).
hub_tab_extension.compact_overview_badge: A compact AI Agent status summary card / pill shown near token stats in Hub header when an Agent profile is configured or draft state exists.

section_1_coin_identity_market.title: Token & Agent Overview
elements: Coin identity badge with avatar, name, symbol, address, and live market cap / volume summary
Agent activation status pill: Draft, Configured, or Simulation Standby
Quick links to DexScreener, Solscan, and Agent config drawer/modal

section_2_agent_profile_mission.title: Agent Profile & Persona
elements: Agent Name, Persona Title (e.g., Market Sentiment Scout, Liquidity Sentinel, Meme Arbitrage Analyst)
Role & Core Mission statement textarea / markdown view
Autonomous Risk Tolerance slider/level selector (Conservative, Balanced, Aggressive, Degenerate)
Operating Mandate & Target Focus Tags (e.g., Meme Trend Detection, Holder Rewards Calculation, Social Hype Score)

section_3_ai_model_selector.title: AI Model & Provider Configuration
elements: Provider selector dropdown (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Llama / Local, ElizaOS / Autonomous Framework)
Model selector options (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, DeepSeek R1, Llama 3.3 70B)
Temperature / Creativity setting, System Prompt customizer, Context Window indicator
Persisted draft configuration state in local storage / backend draft endpoint without live autonomous execution

stages.desc: Scans on-chain liquidity, token holders, and DexScreener volume metrics.
Analyzes social sentiment, Twitter mentions, and community posts.
Synthesizes market data against configured agent risk profile and parameters.
Generates proposed treasury actions, buyback signals, or event suggestions.
Drafts proposed on-chain transaction or announcement payload for authority signature.
Tracks execution feedback, slippage, and holder engagement impact.
Refines prompt context memory based on historical community reaction.

section_5_treasury_token_breakdown.title: Agent Treasury & Token Allocation Breakdown
elements: Allocation breakdown chart / progress bars: Community Rewards (30%), Liquidity Buffer (25%), Marketing Drops (20%), Buyback Reserve (15%), Operational Gas (10%)
Treasury address display with copy trigger

section_6_preview_activity_states.title: Public Activity & Simulation Log
elements: Simulated activity feed showing recent agent observations, research notes, and strategy logs
Draft action proposal card with Copy Payload and Simulate Action preview buttons
Activity log status badges: Observed, Drafted, Simulated

component_instructions.data_test_ids: Mandatory kebab-case data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, cards, dropdowns, and agent configuration controls.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Preserve all existing routes: Trade, Market, Events, Community, Launch, Explore, Wallet.
Add the AI Agent tab (/token/:address/agent) as an additive enhancement to Token Hub.
Maintain MART's established dark mode visual system: #080b0d canvas, #101517 surface, #00efa0 emerald accents, #232b2d borders.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds without blur or semi-solid backing.
Use Radix / custom dropdowns and custom styled forms for model/provider selection.
Include kebab-case data-testid on all interactive elements across the agent module and cloned app.
